user.title: Anthropic API credit
user.description:
Anthropic has no API that returns your credit balance, so this works it out: the balance you enter below, minus what Anthropic reports you have spent since that day.

You need an Admin API key (starts with sk-ant-admin). Create one in the Claude Console under Settings, Admin keys. A normal API key will not work.

data.balance: Credit balance right after your last top-up (USD)

data_description.balance: Look it up in the Claude Console under Settings, Billing. You can change it later with Configure.
data_description.top_up_date: Spend from this day on (UTC) is subtracted from the balance.
